name: vanet-traffic-system
description: VANET-based intelligent traffic signal control: SUMO + Python simulation, Node gateway, React dashboard

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.dev:mock: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev:mock" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server start
scripts.test: npm run test:py && npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.test:e2e: cross-env E2E_REAL=1 npm --prefix server test -- test/e2e.real.test.js
scripts.sim:tune: node scripts/py.mjs sim/optimizer/ga_tuner.py --target signals && node scripts/py.mjs sim/optimizer/ga_tuner.py --target aco
